reason: AZZ is a service provider that applies hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating to customers' steel, with a smaller electrical products line. PPG makes and sells paints and coatings as products. Both address corrosion protection of infrastructure and industrial assets and sell to industrial customers, but the offering (galvanizing and coating services vs. paint and coating materials) and the business model differ. PPG's coverage of aerospace, automotive, architectural and optical materials is much broader than AZZ's.
